meta.tagline: 剖开一块不用电的表：三套系统按能量流向逐一染色，抽走擒纵后齿轮疯转，最后放慢到 1/40 等那一声滴答。

spec.upstream_line: A watch with no battery is cut open: its three systems are dyed one by one, the train races when the escapement is pulled out, and one slowed tick lets it all out again.
